research_question: Can an issue-time, source-provenance integrity gate identify when a solar-particle forecast should be withheld or degraded more reliably than the model's own confidence under source outages, staleness, non-equivalent schemas, and other evidence failures?
core_scientific_claim_if_supported: Forecast confidence and forecast evidential validity are distinct quantities. A model-agnostic gate built only from issue-time source integrity can identify high-confidence forecasts whose evidential support is insufficient, and can improve selective reliability relative to confidence-only abstention under preregistered degradation conditions.

not_claimed_novel: SEP forecasting with proton or soft-X-ray inputs
abstention or selective prediction in machine learning
novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution: A source-provenance-driven, model-output-independent forecast-integrity gate for SEP warning that treats causal availability, authentication, schema equivalence, freshness, and declared quality as separate from predictive confidence, and evaluates integrity-confidence discordance under space-weather source failures.

allowed_development_evidence: already-inspected missingness and outage prediction artifacts
prospective source-preflight receipts that emitted no forecast probability

candidate_selector.name: EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY
hard_zero_conditions: required source stale at or beyond its frozen maximum age
candidate_selector.continuous_score_when_admissible: minimum across required sources of min(normalized remaining freshness margin, declared quality fraction)
candidate_selector.rationale: weakest-link aggregation avoids outcome-fitted source weights and makes a hard provenance failure impossible to hide behind strong values from other sources

comparators.name: AVAILABILITY_ONLY
comparators.score: predeclared binary/ordinal availability state without model confidence

degradation_families: event-bearing terminal outage where existing receipts permit
source staleness or freshness-margin degradation where timestamp receipts permit

preferred: frozen logistic or other non-tree baseline if prediction-level outputs exist

primary_endpoints: TSS among non-abstained rows at each coverage
FAR among non-abstained alerts at each coverage

primary_success_gate.required_direction: lower FAR and/or Brier with no more than 0.05 absolute POD loss, evaluated on identical rows and identical frozen predictions
primary_success_gate.generalization_requirement: direction must hold across at least two degradation families and at least two distinct frozen model outputs
primary_success_gate.uncertainty_requirement: paired shared-cluster bootstrap for every selector contrast; no selector-specific, delay-specific, or coverage-specific resampling tables
primary_success_gate.strong_claim_requirement: for any claim of statistically established advantage, the preregistered paired 95% interval for the primary contrast must exclude zero

falsification_conditions: confidence-only abstention matches or outperforms evidence-integrity selection across preregistered coverage levels
integrity selection improves FAR only by losing more than 0.05 absolute POD
results reverse across frozen model families
source-integrity ranking requires outcome-fitted weights or post-result threshold changes
prediction-level evidence is insufficient to reproduce every primary endpoint

statistical_contract.bootstrap_unit: complete SEP episode or preregistered quiet block

mandatory_evidence_package: per_issue_predictions.csv with issue_time unit_id label frozen probabilities selector scores and scenario identifiers
per_issue_source_integrity.csv with source-level blockers ages quality and schema/causality flags
attrition_ledger.json with counts and reasons at every exclusion step
bootstrap_draws or reproducible bootstrap seed+ordered-unit manifest shared across all contrasts
